# Fixtures

`jpl_new_moons.csv` and `jpl_solar_terms.csv` are copied unchanged from
[qelunai-lunar](https://github.com/qelunai/qelunai-lunar) `reference/` (commit 39f1016).
They were generated by `qelunai-lunar/tool/jpl_reference.py` with Skyfield from NASA JPL's
DE440s ephemeris: New Moon instants and the 24 solar-term crossings (apparent geocentric
ecliptic longitude of date, multiples of 15°), 1899-12 to 2101-01, as local time UTC+7.

The CSV files hold only instants computed by the qelunai-lunar project from that ephemeris;
no ephemeris file or code from JPL is included.

Used by `test/jpl.test.mjs`.
